title: The 18:00: a note-taker, then two decisions with a date, then the parking
detail: (1) Name a note-taker in the first minute: the 5 November 18:00 still has no record; today's 12:00 has one thanks to Angelo's notes. (2) Dated today: the garment files, Dinis's yes or Monday's collection slips (WS-48, with Jose's navy question), and the outreach claim (WS-26, Silvio sends from Friday). (3) Park every late, unowned issue until after the summit (Vicky and Dinis; project-manager@web-summit.dinis has the list: 45 to park, 21 kept). (4) Then the ranked rest: WS-09, WS-107, WS-125, WS-177. 23 decisions open. Say each as 'decided: <item>: <words>'.

closed.why: An order for the 6 November 18:00, which has passed. Its asks carry over in their own items.
